title: Actions against Use of PMDs on Roads in Private Landed Estates
what_it_is: Actions against Use of PMDs on Roads in Private Landed Estates

sections.label: LTA enforcement on PMDs
sections.summary: LTA focuses enforcement on high-traffic roads and high-feedback areas, and acts immediately on footpath obstruction feedback in private landed estates.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: The Land Transport Authority (LTA) has focused its enforcement on roads with high traffic and areas with high public feedback.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: In 2018, 616 people were caught riding PMDs on roads, of which an estimated 18% were caught for riding on minor roads in private landed estates.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: When LTA receives feedback on obstruction on footpaths in private landed estates, LTA acts immediately to remove the item if it causes imminent danger to other path users.

sections.label: Fine for public street obstruction
sections.summary: Offenders who cause obstruction on public streets are liable for a fine of up to $2,000.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Transport)
